subject: HeliosCare — Custom eval kickoff & Redwood data/spec checklist
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Desai <maya@helioscare.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@helioscare.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: HeliosCare custom eval kickoff & next steps

Hi Maya / Liam — great meeting today, thank you for walking us through the HeliosCare use case (automated triage + note summarization). Quick recap and proposals so we have a single source of truth: 

What we recommend for the initial eval
- Models to baseline on Redwood: RW-7B-chat (float16), RW-13B-chat (int8 quantized). RW-7B for latency-sensitive flows; RW-13B for quality ceiling.
- Evaluation types: 1) structured extraction (entities + codes), 2) free-text summarization (note-level) with semantic similarity scoring, 3) safety/PII checks.

Dataset & format (please see attached helios_sample_dataset.jsonl for an example):
- Format: JSONL, newline-delimited. Required top-level fields: "id" (string), "input" (string prompt / clinical note), "expected_response" (string or structured JSON for extractions), "metadata" (JSON string with source, de-id flag, note type).
- Size recommendation: start with 200–500 representative examples (stratified across inpatient/outpatient notes).
- DO NOT include raw PHI — de-identify before upload. If you need, we can provide a small redaction script.

Scoring & rubric (high level)
- Extraction tasks: token-level F1 + exact match for key identifiers (ICD/CPT codes) with per-field weights.
- Summaries: combination of ROUGE-L for surface similarity and embedding cosine (sentence-transformer) for semantic match; expected baseline target: embedding cosine >= 0.78 for acceptable.
- Regression guardrail: we’ll run baseline comparisons against your current production model to surface quality regressions; automated alerts for >5% drop in weighted score.

Security & upload options
- Secure upload: presigned S3 link (preferred) or direct upload to a dedicated Redwood Private workspace (we can spin up temporary folder with KMS).
- Retention: default 30 days after run unless you request persistence.

Attached: sample prompts CSV (helios_sample_prompts.csv), sample dataset JSONL, and our eval runbook (redwood-eval-runbook.pdf) which includes the scoring scripts and example dashboards.

Next steps
1) You to provide 200–500 de-identified samples by Friday (7/24) or indicate if you need the redaction helper.
2) We provision a canary eval run (RW-7B & RW-13B) and return a dashboard with per-metric breakdown within 3 business days of data receipt.
3) Review together and iterate on prompt set / thresholds.

If OK, I’ll loop in Karthik for provisioning and Ben for scoring config.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: helios_sample_prompts.csv (CSV, 24KB); helios_sample_dataset.jsonl (JSONL, 120KB); redwood-eval-runbook.pdf (PDF, 850KB)

From: Maya Desai <maya@helioscare.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@helioscare.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: HeliosCare custom eval kickoff & next steps

Thanks Priya — this is clear and very helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Scoring weights: for HeliosCare prioritization we want entity extraction to be 60% of the weighted score (clinical codes + patient identifiers), summarization 30%, safety checks 10%. Can we bake that into the scoring config?
2) Baselines: we will provide outputs from our current in-house model (v2.1) so you can run head-to-head. Can Redwood ingest two datasets (input + model-A output) for paired comparisons?
3) Upload: we prefer presigned S3. Do you have an S3 path template and an expiration policy we should follow? Also confirm whether we can opt to keep artifacts for 90 days instead of 30 (for internal review).

We’ll start preparing a 300-example stratified sample and expect to have it ready by Friday. One more ask: can you confirm whether the runbook’s scoring script includes a loose-match entity normalization step (e.g., mapping lab names & synonyms)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

—Maya
Director of Clinical ML, HeliosCare
maya@helioscare.ai

Quoted text from Priya Natarajan below:
> Hi Maya / Liam — great meeting today, thank you for walking us through the HeliosCare use case (automated triage + note summarization). Quick recap and proposals so we have a single source of truth: ...

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Desai <maya@helioscare.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam@helioscare.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: HeliosCare custom eval kickoff & next steps

Thanks Maya — great questions, answers inline: 

1) Scoring weights: yes — we can configure the eval harness to apply per-task weights. I’ll put the 60/30/10 split into the scoring config and share the JSON config prior to the run. You’ll be able to override thresholds in the dashboard.

2) Paired comparisons: we support paired ingestion. Recommended structure: JSONL where each record contains "input", "gold", "baseline_model_output". The scoring harness will compute delta metrics (baseline vs candidate) and surface regression deltas. See example in attached helios_sample_dataset.jsonl (fields: id, input, expected_response, baseline_output).

3) S3 presigned uploads: we will generate presigned PUT URLs that expire in 72 hours by default. If you need longer, we can extend and add an approval step. For retention, we can accommodate 90 days for this pilot — please confirm in writing and we’ll set retention to 90 days and tag artifacts accordingly. All artifacts will be encrypted at rest with KMS.

4) Entity normalization & loose-match: the runbook includes an optional normalization pass (canonicalization maps + fuzzy matching using token-level similarity). We usually recommend a manual mapping review for clinical lab synonyms — if you share a short mapping table (CSV), we’ll import it into the scoring pipeline.

Operational next steps (timeline)
- You: confirm retention = 90 days and share sample dataset by 2026-07-24 EOD.
- Redwood: provision presigned S3 path + scoring config by end of day 7/22.
- Redwood: run canary tests on receipt, deliver dashboard within 3 business days.

I’ve attached the scoring-config template and updated runbook. I’ll loop Karthik to provision the environment and Ben to prepare the scoring pipeline.

Best,
Priya

Attachments: redwood-eval-runbook.pdf (updated); helios_sample_dataset.jsonl (example populated with baseline_output field)

Ben:
